M1.reason: Outline matches the brief's words: a hunched, forward-leaning figure in all side views (left, right, front-left, back-left), a wide coat, long arms reaching to mid-thigh, and feet on the floor. Nothing sticks out or is missing in the outline.

M2.reason: Measured height is 68.2 against the brief's 68 (0.3% off). Width 33.1 and length 42 are within 15% of the brief's size; the brief gives only a height.

M3.reason: Lab coat, green head, long clawed hands, dark trousers and boots are all there. The parasite is only a small tan dome on top of the green head (front, left and top views), not a body over the head, so the brief's parasite part reads as a cap. A dark wedge-shaped object is held at the hip in the left, right, front-left and back-left views and in the walk and attack frames; the brief asks for no weapon or extra part. The coat's torn edge shows only faintly (a ragged hem in the front view), so the torn coat is hard to find.

M4.reason: White lab coat, pale green skin on head and hands, dark grey trousers and boots, and red blood on the coat all match the brief's scientist with a parasite. No region is off in colour or material against the brief.

M5.reason: Blood splatters on the chest, front-left and back-right views are present and sharp. The coat's mottled diagonal checker texture reads as grain, not wear. The tears in the coat hem (front, front-right) are only faint, so the torn look the brief asks for is weak. The dark wedge at the hip is an unexplained marking.

M6.reason: Picked once in four readings (asset at D and picked; the other three times the judges picked C or D as the odd one out), under the twice-or-more line for a score of 1. Capped at 2 for this leg.

M7.reason: The front is the front: the green head and the chest blood face the front view. It stands upright on both feet in the walk and attack frames and in the front view.

M8.reason: Measured triangles are 574: under twice the Half-Life median (504) and under the three-quarter line (731), so within the kind's band. Nothing visible is open or floating in the front, side, back or top views. The dark disc on the underside in the below view is seen only from beneath, which a player rarely sees.

C1.reason: In the 23-frame walk, the legs swing, the arms and claws move with the body, and the hunch holds. In the 7-frame attack the forearms and claws come up and slash forward. No part comes apart, sinks or floats. The attack's slashing motion is small, and the dark wedge at the hip moves with the hand.
